zh-CN.title: 投稿审批流程完善
items: 官方和运营可在“我的投稿”与“审批投稿”之间切换，投稿双方身份与处理状态清晰展示
草稿、待处理、待补充、待发布和已发布拥有独立的发送与撤回规则
审批者可选取投稿消息直接发布到广场，发言正文会自动带入投稿标题

en.title: A complete submission review flow
items: Official accounts and operators can switch between their own submissions and review queue, with clear roles and statuses
Draft, review, revision, ready, and published states now enforce the correct send and recall rules
Reviewers can select submission messages and publish them to Square with the submission title prefilled
